CheckTitle: DynamoDB DAX Clusters without encryption in transit
Description: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) Clusters do not have endpoint encryption enabled for data in transit.
Risk: Without cluster endpoint encryption, database traffic may be intercepted leading to exposed data or tampering.

Recommendation.Text: Enforce TLS for all new DAX endpoints and clients. Consider migrating existing clusters to new TLS-enabled clusters, for enforced encryption in transit.
